objective: Bounded sequential one-factor PPO parameter search using fixed C mixed training as baseline

short_order.label: lr-low
short_order.compared_with: C short checkpoint at same 313344 samples

short_order.label: lr-high
short_order.compared_with: C short checkpoint at same 313344 samples

short_order.label: entropy
short_order.compared_with: selected learning rate at same 313344 samples

short_selection: A candidate passes only if at least two of three paired training seeds improve, mean score gain is at least 5 points, and neither group's mean coverage falls by more than 0.01. Choose the highest passing learning-rate candidate, else baseline 0.0001; test entropy after that and keep it only if it passes against selected learning rate.
full_selection: Only the selected changed configuration receives three full-budget runs. Compare all three seeds with C at 1044480 samples; keep as a development candidate only if at least two paired scores improve, mean gain is at least 5, and neither group's mean coverage falls more than 0.01. Otherwise retain C training configuration and stop.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed two learning-rate directions and one entropy direction have been screened, or after the selected changed configuration has been fully verified. Do not extend budget or add configurations based on individual high scores.

development_evaluation.inference_policy: Original exported PPO only; no target/avoid postprocessing during parameter selection

final_confirmation: Do not use A4 final-confirmation suite for tuning
